text: Such pertinent questions are far from being illbred or troublesome to those of whom you ask them; on the contrary, they are a tacit compliment to their knowledge; and people have a better opinion of a young man, when they see him desirous to be informed.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter CLV, to his son, London, January 2, Old Style 1752
